title: Return-value isolation
spec: Implement labels(record). record contains a labels list of strings. Return a separate list with the same strings; caller modifications to the returned list must not change record. Nested objects are out of scope.
target_defect: The returned list aliases the stored list and allows mutation of the record.
author_rationale: The change makes label retrieval a small direct accessor.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
